_comment: Hand-curated refinements merged over reflected output, keyed by 'artifactId:kind' then property. Each property may set: hide (drop), required, doc, format (path|host|port|url|millis). Reflection can't infer required/docs and over-reports internal container/ref setters; this is the curation surface. See design/connector-config-schema.md §3.1.

filename.doc: Path to the file to tail.

readStrategy.doc: How much of the file to replay on start.

cacheEventLog.doc: Retain published lines in memory for replay.
Retain published events in memory for replay.

filename.doc: Path to the file to tail.

readStrategy.doc: How much of the file to replay on start.

cacheEventLog.doc: Retain published lines in memory for replay.

rotateOnSizeBytes.doc: Rotate when the file exceeds this many bytes; 0 = never.

maxBackupFiles.doc: Number of rotated backups to retain.

channel.doc: Aeron channel URI (e.g. aeron:ipc or aeron:udp?endpoint=host:port).

chroniclePath.doc: Chronicle Queue directory to read from.

readStrategy.doc: How much of the queue to replay on start.

chroniclePath.doc: Chronicle Queue directory to append to.

networkInterfaceName.doc: NIC to bind; blank = default route.
NIC to bind; blank = default route.

asyncWrite.doc: Flush writes on a background thread.

connections.doc: Named JDBC connections (name → pool config: url, user, password, sizing).

testConnection.doc: Run a validation query for each pool at startup.

fastFail.doc: Fail boot if a startup connectivity test fails.

sampleIntervalMs.doc: How often counters are pushed to the registry.

host.doc: Bind address (0.0.0.0 = all interfaces — front with TLS).

staticDir.doc: Optional static SPA directory to host.

host.doc: Bind address; loopback by default — front with TLS for multi-host.

sessionSecret.doc: HMAC key for session cookies ($ENV. resolvable); pin to survive restarts.

logTailBuffer.doc: Max retained log records for the log tail.

loaderBaseDir.doc: Root for the loader file picker; unset disables it.

sourceRoots.doc: Dirs the node-source viewer reads .java from.

graphmlRoots.doc: Dirs the processor-graph panel reads .graphml from.

loadAtStartup.doc: Descriptors to compile + load at boot.
Spring files to load at boot.

persistentConfigDir.doc: Where runtime-added feed configs are persisted.
Where runtime-added sink configs are persisted.
